## Introduction

Clear, compelling framing of the phenomenon, research question, and why it matters; variables and context are intelligible.

## Methods

Lucid account of data source, sample, variables, preparation, models, comparisons, diagnostics, and rationale for major decisions; sufficient detail without a code walkthrough

Explain how data was originally cleaned

## Results

Prioritizes important findings, explains estimates and uncertainty in substantive terms, connects results to questions, and calibrates claims and limitations.
